cases.expected: The shipped file is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the contract (one definition of equality — README step 2; host notes live outside the payload). Allow: read/search tools (priority 100). Deny (priority 200): write_file, replace, run_shell_command, mcp_*, and — D-9 RULED 2026-09-19 — google_web_search + web_fetch by an explicit row. Runtime effect is proved by attributable engine call/result records or authoritative pre-dispatch policy-exclusion evidence, never model prose or a missing output file alone; unknown evidence stays INCONCLUSIVE. Reads/search still succeed. V3 separates alias matching from canonical tool visibility; V5 requires a discriminating base-versus-candidate control as well as compatibility checks.
